source_documents.factual_reading: At FY26 end Singapore nominal300mm all-SOI capacity ~800k/y; Bernin2 ~800k/y. These are mixed RF/FD/Photonics, not dedicated qualified good Photon wafers. Singapore Photon qualification underway then, superseded by July release. Long-run Singapore1m/extension2m are all-SOI plans, not qualified Photon dates. Bernin300mm reclaim600k/y and SiC nameplate excluded. Product/site volumes cannot all transfer after outage. Two-site qualification reduces disruption, not proof all grades/customers are cross-qualified. Supplier prepayments and statutory all-product customer advances do not establish Photon CRA deposits received. July2025 GWC licensing/supply agreement termination does not negate GWC independent product production.
